skill.heavy_strike.desc: 1.8x damage and Stun vs. broken armor.
skill.execute.desc: 2x damage to Stunned target, 3x if below 25% HP.
skill.iron_wall.desc: Shield equal to 25% of max HP.
skill.whirlwind.desc: Hits all enemies, 1.7x to Bleeding ones.
boss.bone_king.phase2: Enough! Now I'm serious... I think.
map.escape_confirm: Grab your loot and run? You'll lose the boss reward.
treasure.title: Treasure Room
treasure.text: A dusty chest sits in the corner. It looks a bit too innocent.
rest.title: Campfire
rest.text: A warm fire. The nicest thing you'll find in a cellar.
event.left: Wise. Or maybe not. You'll never know.
event.fountain.title: Suspicious Fountain
event.fountain.text: Green, bubbling water. It smells... interesting.
event.fountain.bad: That didn't sit well. You lost 15% of your HP.
event.merchant.title: Lost Merchant
event.merchant.text: "I've lost my way, but I seem to have found a customer!" Sells a potion for 50 gold.
event.merchant.bye: "I'll be here. Always here. Anyone know the way out?"
event.skull.title: Talking Skull
event.skull.text: "The more of it there is, the less you see. What is it?"
event.skull.right: "Correct! Take this, it fell out of an adventurer's pocket. I don't have pockets anyway."
event.altar.title: Cursed Altar
event.altar.text: A red crystal demands blood. It promises power in return.
event.altar.done: Power in your veins! ATK +15% for this run.
run.cleared_hint: The Bone King's crown got bent. He'll fix it next time.
run.escaped_hint: The loot's in your pocket. The King awaits.
run.died_hint: Half your gold stayed in the cellar. Don't forget combos!
item.bone_crown.desc: The Bone King's crooked crown. Makes the wearer feel a bit royal.
town.name: Emberton
town.gate.title: Dungeon Gate
bag.title: Bag
bag.empty: Your bag is empty. Loot awaits in the dungeon!
smith.title: Blacksmith
smith.line: "WHAT? AN UPGRADE? BRING IT HERE, LET ME SEE!"
merchant.title: Merchant
merchant.line: "Welcome, sweetie! Everything's handmade, some of it by my own hands."
merchant.potion_desc: Restores 35% HP in battle. Carry up to {max}.
merchant.restock: New stock arrives after every run.
resume.title: Unfinished Run
resume.text: Your {dungeon} run is unfinished (room {room}). Pick up where you left off?
run.bag_full: Bag was full, {n} items salvaged (+{gold} gold).
item.rat_fang.desc: The Cellar Rat's royal fang. Still gnaws a little.
item.spore_cloak.desc: The Mushroom Mage's favorite cloak. Makes whoever touches it itch.
item.mimic_ring.desc: A tiny chest mouth. Sniffs out gold, sometimes bites.
item.warden_axe.desc: The Cellar Warden opened doors with this. And whoever came through them.
item.kingslayer.desc: What the Bone King fears most. Second place: brooms.
perk.bleed_on_hit: Hits have a {v}% chance to apply Bleed
perk.thorns: Reflect {v}% of damage taken to the attacker
perk.lifesteal: Steal HP equal to {v}% of damage dealt
market.title: Adventurers' Market
market.line_offline: "The board's full! These adventurers post new goods after every run. Your listings go up here too."
market.line_online: "The board's full! Every listing here is from a real adventurer. Gold from your sales lands in your mail."
market.sell_pick: Pick an item to sell. Equipped items can't be sold.
market.runs_left: On the board for {n} more runs
market.news_sold: {n} of your items sold at the market! Check your mail.
market.err_too_many: You can have at most 5 listings.
market.err_fee: Not enough gold for the listing fee.
market.err_own: You can't buy your own listing.
market.err_offline: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
skill.flame_burst.desc: 2x damage to Burning target, consumes Burn.
skill.ice_lance.desc: Ice damage, 1 Freeze stack. 3 stacks cause Stun.
skill.shatter.desc: 1.5x to Frozen target, +0.5x per Freeze stack.
skill.meteor.desc: Hits all enemies; 1.5x to Burning ones.
skill.backstab.desc: Guaranteed crit on Poisoned or Stunned target.
skill.poison_burst.desc: Deals all remaining poison damage instantly.
skill.shadow_step.desc: 3x damage to Stunned target, refunds Energy.
item.ember_rod.desc: The Cellar Warden lit lanterns with this. Sometimes not lanterns.
item.grave_scepter.desc: The Bone King's scepter. Still gives orders on its own.
item.nightfang.desc: Forged from the King's shadow. Sharper in the dark.
class_master.title: Class Master
class_master.line: "Sword, staff or dagger? The adventurer who tries them all lives longest."
class_master.learned: "You've learned the way of the {class}. Your weapon's in your bag; the rest is up to you."
class_master.switched: "Now you fight as a {class}. Same armor, different temper."
class_master.busy: "You have an unfinished run. Finish that first."
class_master.loadout_hint: Tap a slot, then pick the skill to put there. You bring 4 skills into battle.
class_master.motto.warrior: Break shields, then skulls. Fueled by Rage, stronger with every hit taken.
class_master.motto.mage: Burn it, then blast it. Mana refills every turn; HP is low.
class_master.motto.rogue: Poison, wait, finish. Flurry: two skills in one turn.
room.boss.hint.rotten_cellar: The Bone King sits on his throne
room.boss.hint.burnt_keep: The Ember Priestess began the rite
boss.spore_mother.phase2: You can't... take... the relic from me!
boss.frostbreath.phase2: Dragons aren't extinct, human. We're just hiding from you!
boss.ember_priestess.phase2: The ritual won't stop! The dragons will awaken!
boss.ashwing.phase2: My little ones, guard the nest!
boss.ashwing.phase3: I hid them for a hundred years. Am I to hand them to some adventurer?
perk.poison_on_hit: Hits have a {v}% chance to apply Poison
perk.burn_on_hit: Hits have a {v}% chance to apply Burn
perk.freeze_on_hit: Hits have a {v}% chance to apply Freeze
item.sporeheart_amulet.desc: Still beating. A bit too fast.
item.shroom_cap.desc: The Shroom Brute's cap. Soft, but surprisingly sturdy.
item.mother_mantle.desc: Its mushrooms bite anyone who touches you.
item.frost_ring.desc: Your finger's always cold. Your enemies get it worse.
item.yeti_hide.desc: The yeti cub didn't want to give it up. Now it doesn't care at all.
item.frostbreath_scale.desc: A young dragon's scale. Ever thought of giving it back?
item.imp_horn.desc: Still warm. Might burn holes in your pockets.
item.flame_knight_helm.desc: The plume never goes out. Neither does your hair.
item.priestess_censer.desc: Ritual smoke still curls from it. Combos hit harder.
item.whelp_tooth.desc: Just a baby tooth. Still sharp.
item.drake_plate.desc: Made from the Elder Drake's scales. Hits back at attackers.
item.ashwing_heart.desc: A spark of Ashwing's fire. Warm and impatient.
item.dragon_egg.desc: The last egg Ashwing entrusted to you. Something is tapping inside.
town.gate.line.rotten_cellar: "More rattling from the cellar. Are you going, or should I grab my broom?"
town.gate.line.mushroom_cave: "There's a strange smell coming from the cave. Not mushrooms. Something worse."
town.gate.line.frozen_pass: "Someone saw a dragon in the pass! I didn't. Don't want to, either."
town.gate.line.burnt_keep: "They say there's a rite at the keep. We weren't invited, but I say we go."
town.gate.line.dragon_lair: "The Dragon's Lair... If you make it back, the tea's on me."
town.gate.line.done: "You cleared every dungeon! Now try Hard Mode, and I'll sip my tea."
town.gate.hard_hint: 3 stars unlock Hard Mode: clear it, clear it with no potions, clear it above half HP.
story.game_intro.1: You must be the new adventurer! I'm Nara, dragonologist. Yes, dragons. Yes, they're extinct. Yes, I'm still researching.
story.game_intro.2: My lab is in the inn's cellar. Well, it was. Now skeletons and someone in a crown have taken it over.
story.game_intro.3: Kick the Bone King out of the cellar and I'll tell you everything I know about dragons. It's not much, but it's exciting!
story.game_intro.keeper.1: The dungeon gate is my job. Come when you're ready and I'll open it. I'll bring my broom, too.
story.rotten_cellar_intro.1: Here's the cellar. That rattling? Skeletons. That squeaking? Rats. That singing... the Bone King.
story.rotten_cellar_intro.2: Tip: break their shield, then hit hard. Combos change everything!
story.rotten_cellar_outro.bone_king.1: My crown... my crown is bent... Nobody... ever... asked about my crown...
story.rotten_cellar_outro.1: Look! A scale fell out from under the crown. It's a dragon scale! Still warm!
story.rotten_cellar_outro.2: The scale points toward the cave. The Mushroom Cave! And Old Kaan can teach you other classes now.
story.mushroom_cave_intro.1: The cave is where the scale points. Watch out for spores, their poison stings.
story.mushroom_cave_intro.2: There should be a dragon relic here. Something called the Spore Mother has been feeding on it. Even the name is bad.
story.mushroom_cave_outro.spore_mother.1: The bone... was warm... For a hundred years... it was warm...
story.mushroom_cave_outro.1: It's a dragon rib. But not from a dead dragon. It was shed, just like snakeskin!
story.mushroom_cave_outro.2: So the dragons didn't die out. We need to head north, to the Frozen Pass. Dress warm!
story.frozen_pass_intro.1: The pass has frost wolves and ice wisps. Fire works. I use it to warm my hands.
story.frozen_pass_intro.keeper.1: Someone saw a dragon, too. Young, cold, grumpy. Just like me in my youth.
story.frozen_pass_outro.frostbreath.1: Enough! You're strong, human. But you must leave us be.
story.frozen_pass_outro.frostbreath.2: The cult is trying to wake the dragons. At the Burnt Keep. If they force us awake... everything burns.
story.frozen_pass_outro.1: A talking dragon! A living dragon! I need to take notes. No, first we need to run. To the Burnt Keep!
story.burnt_keep_intro.1: The cult holds its rites here. The Ember Priestess leads them. She resists fire, but not ice!
story.burnt_keep_intro.2: If we don't stop the rite, the dragons will wake up angry. Just like Frostbreath said.
story.burnt_keep_outro.ember_priestess.1: Fool... Ashwing tried to stop us... but the ritual... was never against Ashwing... it was to save them...
story.burnt_keep_outro.1: Ashwing? Wasn't that the cult's leader? Or... the last dragon?
story.burnt_keep_outro.2: Every trail leads to the Dragon's Lair. Get ready. This is the final journey.
story.dragon_lair_intro.1: The Dragon's Lair. Gold, ash, and very, very big footprints.
story.dragon_lair_intro.kaan.1: Choose your skills well, kid. Ashwing changes three times. Angrier each time.
story.dragon_lair_intro.2: Whatever happens, I'm with you. A little behind you. Okay, way behind you.
story.dragon_lair_outro.ashwing.1: A hundred years... I hid them from humans for a hundred years. Because you hunted us.
story.dragon_lair_outro.ashwing.2: But you're different. You won, yet you didn't touch the eggs.
story.dragon_lair_outro.ashwing.3: Take this. The last egg. Protect it, adventurer. Maybe one day humans and dragons will fly together again.
story.dragon_lair_outro.1: A dragon egg! It's wiggling! This... this is the greatest day in the history of science!
story.dragon_lair_outro.2: Let's head back to Emberton. The egg will hatch soon. The adventure is just beginning!
run.cleared_hint.rotten_cellar: The Bone King's crown got bent. He'll fix it next time.
run.cleared_hint.mushroom_cave: The Spore Mother withered. The cave just smells like mushrooms now.
run.cleared_hint.frozen_pass: Frostbreath spread its wings and retreated to the mountains.
run.cleared_hint.burnt_keep: The ritual is broken. Only ash remains in the keep.
run.cleared_hint.dragon_lair: Ashwing is defeated. The lair is quiet now.
ending.title: The End... For Now
ending.text: Dragons are waking again in Valthera, and one of them is in your bag. You can clear every dungeon on Hard Mode, collect legendary items and trade at the market.
settings.title: Settings
settings.tutorial_done: Nara's tips will show again in your next battle.
settings.reset_confirm: All your progress will be erased: levels, items, gold and unlocked dungeons. This can't be undone. Are you sure?
tut.intent: The badge above an enemy shows its next move. A sword means attack, a shield means defend; the number is the damage you'll likely take.
tut.skills: Your skills are here. First apply a status with a setup skill, then hit big with a finisher. Tap an enemy to target it.
tut.class_warrior: The Warrior uses Rage: it fills each turn and whenever you hit or get hit, and Defend fills extra. Break armor with Shield Break, finish with Execute.
tut.class_mage: The Mage uses Mana. Mana refills each turn, and Defend fills extra. Fire, ice and lightning work differently on each enemy: try another element on resistant ones.
tut.class_rogue: The Rogue uses Energy. As long as you have Energy, you can use several skills in one turn (Flurry), but each extra skill costs a bit more. When done, tap End Turn.
tut.combo: This skill is glowing: the target is primed for a combo! Use it now for extra damage.
tut.defend: Your HP is low! Defend reduces incoming damage and refills your resource. Potions restore HP, but you only get a few per dungeon.
market.err_listed_before: This item was already listed once.
market.err_daily_limit: You've hit today's listing limit. Try again tomorrow.
market.err_buy_limit: You've hit today's buying limit. Try again tomorrow.
market.err_bad_request: The server didn't understand the request.
dragon.title: Dragon Companion
dragon.nara.can_nest: That egg is freezing in your bag! Give it here, we'll put it in the warmest corner of my lab.
dragon.nara.egg: The egg is warming up. Every time you go down a dungeon, it feels you. Not scientifically. But I'm sure.
dragon.nara.ready: It's cracking! IT'S CRACKING! Quick, don't miss it!
dragon.nara.hatched: {name} grows bigger every day. Yesterday it chewed one of my books. Scientific curiosity, I'm sure.
dragon.nest.confirm: The egg leaves your bag and settles in the nest. This can't be undone. Are you sure?
dragon.warmth_hint: Every finished dungeon run warms the egg: cleared, escaped or fallen.
dragon.choose.title: Choose Its Blood
dragon.choose.text: Three colors ripple across the hatchling's scales. Which will win? The choice is permanent.
dragon.effect.frost: Its breath freezes: Freeze (3 stacks stun).
dragon.effect.venom: Its breath poisons: 2 stacks of Poison.
dragon.charge: Breathes once every {n} of your turns.
dragon.xp_hint: Gets double the XP you earn on runs.
tut.dragon: Your dragon is with you! The dots under it fill on each of your turns. When all three are full, it breathes on every enemy.
story.dragon_hatch.1: The crack is growing... a snout! A snout came out! Okay, calm. Scientists stay calm.
story.dragon_hatch.2: It's looking at you. It knows you! Ashwing's egg grew with your warmth.
story.dragon_hatch.3: Its scales haven't made up their mind. Fire, frost or venom? Maybe you can help.
